chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz, from Is'haq ibn Abd al-Aziz and Jamil and Zurara, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

From what the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) taught Fatima (peace be upon her) is that he said to her: 'O Fatima! The one who believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him honor his guest.'
ai.seo_question: What is the prophetic teaching regarding the relationship between faith and hospitality?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this hadith highlights the intimate transmission of prophetic wisdom to Fatima al-Zahra (peace be upon her), underscoring her role as a primary conduit of Sunnah in Shia tradition. It elevates hospitality from mere social courtesy to a definitive marker of Iman (faith) and readiness for the Hereafter, linking the treatment of guests directly to one's spiritual standing. This teaching reinforces the Shia emphasis on the practical application of faith through ethical conduct within the domestic sphere.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Umar Bin Abdul Aziz, from Is’haq Bin Abdul Aziz, and Jameel, and Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘From what Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> taught Fatima<sup>asws</sup> is that he<sup>saww</sup> said to her<sup>asws</sup>: ‘O Fatima<sup>asws</sup>! The one who was a believer in Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and the Last Day, so let him be benevolent with his guest’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from ‘Umar ibn ‘Abd al-’Aziz from Ishaq ibn ‘Abd al-’Aziz and Jamil and Zurarah who have said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has stated this Hadith.

‘Of the matters that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, taught to Fatimah, ‘Alayha al-Salam, was his saying, “O Fatimah, whoever believes in Allah and in the Day of Judgment, he must honor his guest.’””
